---
title: "K–12 Cybersecurity and Data Privacy Research Analysis"
output: html_notebook
---
This notebook provides an exploratory analysis of survey data related to technology training, educator technology confidence, and cybersecurity and data privacy preparedness in K–12 education. The analysis uses preliminary survey data to identify potential relationships among these factors and support the development of a practical K–12 Cyber Safety Framework. Because the current dataset is exploratory and limited in size, the findings are used to identify patterns and guide future research rather than establish causal or nationally representative conclusions.


```{r}

install.packages(c("tidyverse", "ggplot2", "patchwork"))

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)
install.packages(c("dplyr", "tidyr"))

remove.packages("readxl")
install.packages("readxl")
library(readxl)
library(dplyr)
library(tidyr)
```

```{r}
library(ggplot2)
library(dplyr)


ggplot(data, aes(x = `Last Training`)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "When Teachers Last Received Technology Training",
    x = "Time Since Last Training",
    y = "Number of Respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```


```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(x = `Preparedness`)) +
  geom_bar() +
  labs(
    title = "Teacher Preparedness After Technology Training",
    x = "Preparedness Level",
    y = "Number of Respondents"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1))
```

```{r}
cybersecurity_training_frequency <- data %>%
  count(`Training Frequency`, `Cybersecurity Training`) %>%
  group_by(`Training Frequency`) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  ) %>%
  ungroup()

cybersecurity_training_frequency
```
```{r}
training_summary <- data %>%
  count(`Training Frequency`) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

preparedness_summary <- data %>%
  count(`Preparedness`) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

confidence_summary <- data %>%
  count(`Troubleshooting Confidence`) %>%
  mutate(
    Percentage = round(n / sum(n) * 100, 1)
  )

training_summary
preparedness_summary
cybersecurity_summary
confidence_summary
```

```{r}
ggplot(data, aes(
  x = `Training Frequency`,
  fill = `Preparedness`
)) +
  geom_bar(position = "dodge") +
  labs(
    title = "Relationship Between Training Frequency and Preparedness",
    subtitle = "More frequent training is associated with higher reported preparedness",
    x = "Training Frequency",
    y = "Number of Respondents",
    fill = "Preparedness"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
